abi.heading: ESI pod; cdecl(direction pointer, factor float, mode int)
abi.vectorZ: cdecl(output pointer, input pointer, signed Int32 angle)

bounds: Finite used matrix/vector/curve/factor/delta words and arithmetic results; representable float-to-int conversions.
Exact supplied 32,768 runtime sine floats and 513 original angle words; table initialization remains external.
Caller scratch is 48 disjoint bytes outside all retained source/matrix storage; native stack-local allocation is projected into this buffer.
No machine flags, FPU status/exception masks, register clobber, partial memory faults or NaN behavior equivalence claim.
CreatePod orchestration and actor creator remain unrecovered in this batch.
behavior: Transform direction through current pod matrix, publish sign-extended short yaw/pitch at +74/+70, apply in-place Y then X rotations.
Nonzero mode applies fixed roll 512 and skips bank calculation. Mode zero rereads direction after matrix writes, including aliases.
Curve angle is truncated to Int32 then signed16 before adding 0x4000; local unit X rotates Z, X, Y, then transforms through updated matrix.
Clamp bank first against 24000*delta, then -24000*delta; every clamp truncates and wraps signed16, preserving negative delta and wrap effects.
Factor >2 sets bank zero; factor >1 scales by 2-factor with F32 spill; <=1 preserves bank. Final signed16 conversion feeds negated in-place Z rotation.
Z-vector rotation caches X but rereads input Y after X store and Z after Y store; shifted alias behavior retained.
